fixes.explanation: That's a fair guess, friend, but it isn't what Jesus says. He says the sickness is “…for the glory of God, so that the Son of God may be glorified through it.” The text doesn't call it a test of Mary and Martha. Honestly, a test is the first thing I'd have reached for too, so you're in good company.

Good thinking, friend, but a village lesson isn't what Jesus says. He doesn't mention the village at all. What He says is that it's “…for the glory of God, so that the Son of God may be glorified through it.” Only God and His Son are named there, plain as a cookie with no toppings.
